name: Aloe Vera
short_description: A healing plant commonly used for skin care.
full_description: Aloe Vera is known for its thick leaves containing soothing gel. It grows well in warm, dry areas and is widely used in home remedies.
uses: Used for burns, wounds, skin care, and soothing irritated skin.
cultural_importance: Traditionally used in natural medicine and household healing practices.
growing_conditions: Needs sunlight, warm weather, and well-drained soil.

name: Moringa
short_description: A nutritious tree valued for its edible leaves.
full_description: Moringa is an important indigenous food tree in parts of East Africa. Its leaves are rich in nutrients and are often cooked as a vegetable.
uses: Leaves are eaten as food and may be used in traditional health practices.
cultural_importance: Valued by local communities as a reliable food source during dry seasons.
growing_conditions: Grows in warm climates and tolerates dry conditions once established.

name: African Olive
short_description: A hardy evergreen tree found in highland areas.
full_description: African Olive is a strong evergreen tree that grows in mountain forests and wooded highlands. It is known for its durable wood and ecological value.
uses: Used for shade, traditional tools, timber, and soil protection.
cultural_importance: Respected in many communities for its strength and long life.
growing_conditions: Prefers highland climates, moderate rainfall, and well-drained soil.

name: Hagenia
short_description: A highland tree known for traditional medicinal uses.
full_description: Hagenia is a flowering tree found in cool African mountain forests. Its flowers have been used in traditional medicine, but careful handling is important.
uses: Traditionally used in herbal preparations and valued for forest restoration.
cultural_importance: Part of highland forest knowledge and traditional healing history.
growing_conditions: Needs cool highland conditions, moisture, and fertile soil.

name: Enset
short_description: A staple food plant sometimes called false banana.
full_description: Enset is a major indigenous food crop in Ethiopia. Although it looks like a banana plant, its stem and root parts are processed into traditional foods.
uses: Used to make kocho, bulla, animal feed, and household materials.
cultural_importance: Central to food security, farming systems, and cultural identity in many communities.
growing_conditions: Requires fertile soil, regular moisture, and mild to warm conditions.

name: Koseret
short_description: A fragrant herb used for flavoring and traditional remedies.
full_description: Koseret is an aromatic plant with leaves used in cooking and traditional medicine. It is appreciated for its strong pleasant scent.
uses: Used as a spice, tea ingredient, and traditional household remedy.
cultural_importance: Common in local food culture and home gardens.
growing_conditions: Grows best in sunny areas with moderate water and well-drained soil.

name: Prickly Pear
short_description: A cactus plant with edible fruits and drought tolerance.
full_description: Prickly Pear grows well in dry environments. Its fruits can be eaten, and the plant is useful in areas where water is limited.
uses: Fruits are eaten fresh, and pads may be used as animal feed.
cultural_importance: Important in dryland communities as a drought-resistant food source.
growing_conditions: Needs full sun, little water, and sandy or rocky soil.

name: Tena Adam
short_description: An aromatic plant used in traditional drinks and remedies.
full_description: Tena Adam is a strongly scented herb often grown near homes. It is used in traditional drinks and household remedies.
uses: Used for flavoring coffee or tea and in traditional wellness practices.
cultural_importance: Often associated with hospitality, home gardens, and traditional knowledge.
growing_conditions: Prefers sunny locations, moderate water, and well-drained soil.
